ideas.pitch: An AI-powered NGINX and server log anomaly detection dashboard built specifically to parse Dr. Meera Kapoor's corrupted server epoch logs and flag unauthorized database commands.
ideas.title: EpochTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the narrative lore of SERVER EPOCH-01, giving judges an immersive tool that looks like it belongs in the recovery room.

ideas.pitch: A terminal-based recovery toolkit with a live countdown timer UI that lets investigators query half-erased filesystem logs and reconstruct the timeline before the wipe bar hits 100%.
ideas.title: WipeGuard CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the ticking-clock format of the 60-minute terminal challenge into an interactive experience judges can test live.

ideas.pitch: An AML-inspired graph intelligence investigator that maps the farewell party card signatures, hallway badge swipes, and late-night database orders to expose who stood behind Dr. Kapoor.
ideas.title: Meera's Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced relationship mapping to solve the whodunit narrative layer of the prompt.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies recovered audio transcripts and fragmented text notes left on Meera's workstation to surface the hidden motive behind the self-erasing server.
ideas.title: Epoch Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a heavy text-parsing challenge efficiently using semantic search over exemplar indexes.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated autonomous agent workflow that automates the extraction, risk diagnosis, and forensic validation of surviving log fragments from SERVER EPOCH-01.
ideas.title: Recovery Agent Maestro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous multi-step agentic orchestration to solve a complex data recovery mission under pressure.
